name: East Rock Sangha
reason: No centre of its own and no usable photo: a New England sangha spread over four small sitting groups (New Haven, Chilmark on Martha's Vineyard, a New Bedford bookshop, Portland ME) that holds sesshin at rented venues; the site has no logo or photo of a zendo (only a Ryoan-ji garden in Kyoto, a calligraphy and a 2019 sesshin group photo). Contact eastrocksangha@gmail.com is published (contact page); teacher Nelson Foster (not on Spiritpedia). Owner could revisit as a distributed listing if a group photo is acceptable.
